title: BookkeeperReceipt
description: Schema for ledger receipts filed by any agent in the JamBot mesh. Required fields: id, ts, who, what, when, why. All other fields are optional but strongly recommended.

id.description: Unique receipt ID. Canonical format: rcpt-YYYYMMDD-<8-char-hex>. Example: rcpt-20260609-a1b2c3d4

ts.description: ISO8601 UTC timestamp when this receipt was filed with Bookkeeper. May differ from 'when' if filed retroactively.

who.description: AGENT_URI of the acting agent. Example: src-desktop@mesh, sms-host@mesh. Use 'unknown' only if provenance is genuinely unresolvable.

what.description: Human-readable description of the action taken. Be specific: 'committed azrim-website auto-save' > 'did some work'.

when.description: ISO8601 UTC timestamp of the action itself. Use the actual action time, not the filing time.

why.description: Context: task ID, ticket reference, decision record, or a brief reason. Must be non-empty.

tool.description: Primary tool or mechanism used. Examples: git, mesh-send, bash, API, Claude-Code, playwright.

proof.description: Verifiable artifact reference. Examples: git:<repo>@<hash>, file:/mnt/..., msg:<agent-path>, url:https://...

tier.description: Receipt category for filtering and reporting. Use 'action' for most work receipts.

tenant.description: Client/tenant context if the action was on behalf of a specific tenant. Omit for mesh-internal actions.

agent_type.description: Agent runtime type. Examples: claude-code, hermes-agent, cron, script.

source.description: How this receipt was generated. Examples: git (auto), mesh-send (auto), agent-direct (agent self-filed), backfill (retroactive).

dedupe_key.description: Normalized string for deduplication. Bookkeeper will reject a receipt if an identical dedupe_key exists within a 2-minute window.

examples.why: Mike directive via SMS: set up text-to-lottie as a video skill on Mac mini
